name: Fujita Yosaku
source:
"If you cook soup with a lion? Animal kingdom, hahahaha!"

A character with a great talent for composing, such as giving advice to various idols' hit songs since middle school. It is said that among the songs he gave advice was the debut song of the super high school level idol, Sayaka Maizono. After he entered Hope's Peak Academy, he is the president of the best agency and his motto is 'creation comes from dripping', and in everyday conversations, various drips are rampant. (There are many cold gag drips, but...) When a drip doesn't work, he says "Smile~ Peace".

He also shows some talent in writing lyrics, but seeing that the title of the song he wrote is 'I LOVE Chicken', that quality is questionable.

[Machine translated from [url=https://dangan.tistory.com/7]official source[/url] and edited where necessary]
